strings.110451:
Declaring War
1. Attacking a city requires the Alliance Leader or an R4 to declare war. 
2. Each alliance can declare war once a day and only on one city at a time. 
3. An alliance must have more than 20 members to declare war. 
4. The war lasts for 12 hours, during which alliance members can attack the city. Multiple alliances can declare war on the same city. 
Attacking Cities
1. The city has NPC defenders that survivors must defeat first; if not defeated quickly, the defenders will recover all HP. 
2. After defeating all defenders, survivors must demolish the city's durability. Troops can initiate demolitions periodically. The city's durability will slowly restore over time, so it's recommended to gather enough survivors for a concentrated attack. 
3. After demolishing all durability, the ownership of the city is determined based on the points obtained by participating alliances (Points = number of defenders killed * defender points + durability demolished * durability points). 
Note: During the demolishment stage, only durability destruction counts toward siege points. Winning the siege itself does not grant additional points. 

Occupation Rules
1. A Level 1 city must be occupied first (the first Level 1 city doesn't need to follow adjacent rules); thereafter, any city your alliance declares war on must be adjacent to your alliance's existing territory.

Contest Rules:

1. Once the event starts, contests for Lv.1/2/3 Trade Hubs begin at 11:00:00 (Apocalypse Time) on Mondays/Wednesdays/Fridays, lasting 1 hour each. 
2. The first week's contests occur within your home state; subsequent rounds are cross-state contests. During cross-state contests, you cannot attack Headquarters from other states outside the Trade Hub area. 
3. Ownership of Trade Hub is individual. Troops from the same alliance do not combat each other within the Hub, but <color=#cf1c20>their capture progress is calculated independently</color>. 
4. When your Headquarters is outside the Trade Hub area, the minimum capture time is 15 minutes. After relocating your Headquarters into the Trade Hub area, <color=#cf1c20>the minimum capture time reduces to 10 minutes</color>-but be warned, after moving in, <color=#cf1c20>you may suffer attacks from other survivors!</color> 
5. If the Trade Hub is unowned, the survivor with the highest capture progress when the contest ends becomes the Owner. If the Hub had an existing owner and no survivor reaches 100% capture progress by the end of the contest, the existing owner retains control. 
6. After ownership of a Trade Hub is confirmed, all alliance members who contributed capture progress at that hub will receive a participation reward. 

Hub Shop Rules:

1. After the contest, the Trade Hub Owner can tap the 'Stock' button to fully replenish the shop's shelves for the week. Alliance members get early access to purchase items. 
2. [Exclusive] items can only be purchased by the owner. The owner's allies enjoy discounted prices on purchasable items. 
3. When the owner chooses to open trade to the public, all survivors within the same season group can use Diamonds to purchase items. 
4. Each item in the Trade Hub Shop can only be purchased once before the next contest opens-first-come-first-served. The total daily purchase attempts for the entire shop are limited. 
5. Daily purchase attempts reset at 11:00:00 (Apocalypse Time).

Tax Rules:

1. After each Trade Hub Contest ends, it enters a new contest phase. A portion of Diamonds earned from successful sales in the Hub Shop during the previous owner's tenure is converted into tax revenue. 
2. When all items in the shop are sold out or the owner steps down, taxes are granted as bonus red packets, allowing the owner to distribute them to alliance members via the chat channel.

Rules: 

1. The main rules are essentially the same as those in the Trade Hub event of the Dinosaur · Origin season. 
2. <color=#cf1c20>New [Night Market] mechanism</color>: When night falls, the shop refreshes with items unique to the Night Market. Survivors can use [Moon Tokens] to purchase these items. The daily purchase limits for Night Market items and daytime items are independent of each other. 
3. <color=#cf1c20>New [Moon Token Dividend Packs]</color>: Moon Tokens spent in the Trade Hub's Night Market will be converted into [Moon Token Dividend Packs] based on the tax rate before the next contest begins. These packs are given to the Trade Hub Owner, who can distribute them to the alliance. Members who claim them receive a random amount of Moon Tokens. 

Contest Rules: 

1. Once the event starts, contests for Lv.1/2/3 Trade Hubs begin at 11:00:00 (Apocalypse Time) on Monday/Wednesday/Friday, lasting for 1 hour each. 
2. The first week's contests occur within your home state; subsequent rounds are cross-state contests. During cross-state contests, you cannot attack Headquarters from other states outside the Trade Hub area. 
3. Ownership of Trade Hubs is individual. Troops from the same alliance do not combat each other within the Hub, but their capture progress is calculated independently. 
4. When your Headquarters is outside the Trade Hub area, the minimum capture time is 15 minutes. After relocating your Headquarters into the Trade Hub area, the minimum capture time reduces to 10 minutes-but be warned, after teleporting in, you may suffer attacks from other survivors! 
5. If the Trade Hub is unowned, the survivor with the highest capture progress when the contest ends becomes the Owner. If the Hub had an existing owner and no survivor reaches 100% capture progress by the end of the contest, the existing owner retains control. 
6. After ownership of a Trade Hub is confirmed, all alliance members who contributed capture progress at that hub will receive a participation reward. 

Trade Hub Shop Rules: 

1. After the contest, the Trade Hub Owner can tap the <Stock> button to fully replenish the shop's shelves for the week. Alliance members get early access to purchase items. 
2. This season, the Trade Hub has a new [Night Market] mechanism. When night falls, the shop refreshes with items that can only be purchased during the night, using [Moon Tokens]. When night ends, these items are temporarily hidden, and the shop continues selling daytime items until the next night falls. 
3. [Exclusive] items can only be purchased by the Owner. The Owner's allies enjoy discounted prices on purchasable items. 
4. When the Owner chooses to open the shop, all survivors within the same season grouping can use Diamonds to purchase items in the daytime shop and Moon Tokens to purchase items in the Night Market. 
5. During both daytime and nighttime, each item in the Trade Hub can only be purchased once before the next contest opens-first come, first served. The daytime shop and the Night Market each have independent daily purchase limits. 
6. Daily purchase attempts reset at 11:00:00 (Apocalypse Time). 

Tax Rules:

1. After each Trade Hub Contest ends, it enters a new contest phase. A portion of Diamonds and Moon Tokens earned from successful sales in the Hub Shop during the previous owner's tenure is converted into tax revenue. 
2. When all items in the shop are sold out, or the Owner steps down, these taxes are distributed to the Owner as tax dividend. Diamond taxes are converted into Trade Dividend Packs, and Moon Token taxes are converted into Moon Token Dividend Packs. The Owner can distribute them to alliance members in the chat channel.
3. Alliance members who claim Trade Dividend Packs receive varying amounts of Diamonds; those who claim Moon Token Dividend Packs receive varying amounts of Moon Tokens.

1. Both sides donate units to form the expeditionary force.

<color=#5fa3ed>Combat Phase</color>:
1. In the Combat Phase, the Alliance Leader and R4 members can manually give the defense command. 
2. Once the defense order is issued, the rival expeditionary force will launch attacks against our Alliance Centers in order starting from Alliance Center Ⅰ. 
3. Our side needs to defend against attacks from the rival expeditionary force. 
4. Event points can be obtained for each wave of attack successfully defended. At the end of the event, the side with higher points will be deemed the winner. 
5. The winning side will loot 20% of Season Points from the losing side.

Contest Rules:

1. Once the event begins, contests for Lv.1/2/3 Trade Hubs within your home State begin at 11:00:00 (Apocalypse Time) on the Monday, Wednesday, and Friday of the first week, lasting for 1 hour each. Starting in Week 2, the Cross-State Trade Hub contest begins every Thursday at 11:00:00 (Apocalypse Time). It opens to survivors of all levels. The event lasts for one hour. 
2. During Cross-State contests, you cannot attack Headquarters from other States outside the Trade Hub area. 
3. Ownership of Trade Hub is individual. Troops from the same alliance do not combat each other within the Trade Hub, <color=#cf1c20>but their capture progress is calculated independently</color>. 
4. When your Headquarters is outside the Trade Hub area, the minimum capture time is 15 minutes. After relocating your Headquarters into the Trade Hub area, <color=#cf1c20>the minimum capture time reduces to 10 minutes</color>-but be warned, after moving in, <color=#cf1c20>you may suffer attacks from other survivors!</color> 
5. If the Trade Hub is unowned, the survivor with the highest capture progress when the contest ends becomes the Owner. If the Trade Hub had an existing owner and no survivor reaches 100% capture progress by the end of the contest, the existing owner retains control. 
6. After ownership of a Trade Hub is confirmed, all alliance members who contributed capture progress at that hub will receive a participation reward. 

Hub Shop Rules:

1. After the contest, the Trade Hub Owner can tap the "Stock" button to fully replenish the shop's shelves for the week. Alliance members get early access to purchase items. 
2. [Exclusive] items can only be purchased by the owner. The owner's allies enjoy discounted prices on purchasable items. 
3. When the owner chooses to open trade to the public, all survivors within the same season grouping can use Diamonds to purchase items. 
4. Each item in the Trade Hub can only be purchased once before the next contest opens-first-come-first-served. The total daily purchase attempts for the entire shop are limited. 
5. Daily purchase attempts reset at 11:00:00 (Apocalypse Time).

Tax Rules:

1. After each Trade Hub Contest ends, it enters a new contest phase. A portion of Diamonds earned from successful sales in the Hub Shop during the previous owner's tenure is converted into tax revenue. 
2. When all items in the shop are sold out or the owner steps down, taxes are granted as bonus red packets, allowing the owner to distribute them to alliance members via the chat channel.

Rules: 

1. The main rules are essentially the same as those in the Trade Hub event of the [Dinosaur · Origin] season. 
2. <color=#cf1c20>New [Night Market] mechanism</color>: When night falls, the shop refreshes with items unique to the Night Market. Survivors can use [Moon Tokens] to purchase these items. The daily purchase limits for Night Market items and daytime items are independent of each other. 
3. <color=#cf1c20>New [Moon Token Dividend Packs]</color>: Moon Tokens spent in the Trade Hub's Night Market will be converted into [Moon Token Dividend Packs] based on the tax rate before the next contest begins. These packs are given to the Trade Hub Owner, who can distribute them to the alliance. Members who claim them receive a random amount of Moon Tokens. 

Contest Rules: 

1. Once the event begins, contests for Lv.1/2/3 Trade Hubs within your home State begin at 11:00:00 (Apocalypse Time) on the Monday, Wednesday, and Friday of the first week, lasting for 1 hour each. Starting in Week 2, the Cross-State Trade Hub contest begins every Thursday at 11:00:00 (Apocalypse Time). It opens to survivors of all levels. The event lasts for one hour. 
2. During Cross-State contests, you cannot attack Headquarters from other States outside the Trade Hub area. 
3. Ownership of Trade Hubs is individual. Troops from the same alliance do not combat each other within the Trade Hub, but their capture progress is calculated independently. 
4. When your Headquarters is outside the Trade Hub area, the minimum capture time is 15 minutes. After relocating your Headquarters into the Trade Hub area, the minimum capture time reduces to 10 minutes-but be warned, after teleporting in, you may suffer attacks from other survivors! 
5. If the Trade Hub is unowned, the survivor with the highest capture progress when the contest ends becomes the Owner. If the Trade Hub had an existing owner and no survivor reaches 100% capture progress by the end of the contest, the existing owner retains control. 
6. After ownership of a Trade Hub is confirmed, all alliance members who contributed capture progress at that hub will receive a participation reward. 

Trade Hub Shop Rules: 

1. After the contest, the Trade Hub Owner can tap the <Stock> button to fully replenish the shop's shelves for the week. Alliance members get early access to purchase items. 
2. This season, the Trade Hub has a new [Night Market] mechanism. When night falls, the shop refreshes with items that can only be purchased during the night, using [Moon Tokens]. When night ends, these items are temporarily hidden, and the shop continues selling daytime items until the next night falls. 
3. [Exclusive] items can only be purchased by the Owner. The Owner's allies enjoy discounted prices on purchasable items. 
4. When the Owner chooses to open the shop, all survivors within the same season grouping can use Diamonds to purchase items in the daytime shop and Moon Tokens to purchase items in the Night Market. 
5. During both daytime and nighttime, each item in the Trade Hub can only be purchased once before the next contest opens-first come, first served. The daytime shop and the Night Market each have independent daily purchase limits. 
6. Daily purchase attempts reset at 11:00:00 (Apocalypse Time). 

Tax Rules:

1. After each Trade Hub Contest ends, it enters a new contest phase. A portion of Diamonds and Moon Tokens earned from successful sales in the Hub Shop during the previous owner's tenure is converted into tax revenue. 
2. When all items in the shop are sold out, or the Owner steps down, these taxes are distributed to the Owner as tax dividend. Diamond taxes are converted into Trade Dividend Packs, and Moon Token taxes are converted into Moon Token Dividend Packs. The Owner can distribute them to alliance members in the chat channel.
3. Alliance members who claim Trade Dividend Packs receive varying amounts of Diamonds; those who claim Moon Token Dividend Packs receive varying amounts of Moon Tokens.

strings.910102:
Event Rules: 
1. During the Arctic Ice Pit event, contests for Level 1, 2, and 3 ice pits start at <color=#c8212d>Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays 11:00:00</color> Apocalypse Time respectively, each lasting for 1 hour. 
2. The Ice Pit Clash takes place in your Home State during the first week of the event, and cross-State clashes in the same season grouping afterward. 
3. At the start of the clash, alliance members need to defeat the Tundra Titan together. Once defeated, the alliance with the highest damage points gains control of the corresponding Ice Pit. 
4. When the Alliance gains control of the Ice Pit, all members who <color=#c8212d>deal damage to the Tundra Titan</color> receive a participation reward. 
5. Teleporting your Headquarters to the area near the Ice Pit grants a 3× damage points bonus, but you may be attacked by other survivors. 
6. If the Tundra Titan is not defeated within the time limit, the Ice Pit re-enters a frozen state.
Fishing and Index: 
1. Once the ice pit is captured, all survivors in the same season grouping can use [Common Fishing Permits] or [Master Fishing Permits] to fish at the pit. 
2. Fishing yields index entries. Reaching collection milestones grants corresponding rewards. 
3. Surplus fish entries may be gifted to others to help complete collections and earn grand prizes! 

Ice Pit Yields: 
1. The capturing survivor receives ice pit capture reward, and alliance members who contribute points receive a participation reward. 
2. Fishing in the ice pit captured by your alliance significantly increases chances for rare fish entries. 
3. When the total number of Fishing Permits collected in the Ice Pit reaches <color=#f07100>{0}</color>, the pit owner will receive a Fishing Red Packet worth <color=#f07100>{1}</color> Diamonds-ready to share with their allies!

As Night Falls, the evil Night Succubus appears in the world! 
1. During Apocalypse Time, at 00:00, 08:00, and 16:00 each day, Night Falls and the world is plunged into darkness. 
2. Each Night Falls lasts for at least 1h. Until the following Monday, the duration of each Night Falls will be extended by 1h compared to the previous week. By Monday on Week 8, the world will enter a state of Endless Night. 
3. During Night Falls (including Endless Night), survivors can team up to defeat the Night Succubus that appears.
4. Ranking is based on the highest level of Night Succubus slain. In case of a tie, the survivor who achieved the kill earlier ranks higher. 
5. Only the survivor who initiates a team-up and slays the Night Succubus will rank.

1. The event is held every Wednesday at 00:10, 08:10, and 16:10 (Apocalypse Time), each session lasting for 50 mins. 
2. After the first session of the event day (00:10), Night Countesses will appear in the top 3 highest-level neutral cities captured by each alliance (excluding the Capital). 
3. Alliance members must team up to slay the Countesses. 
4. A Night Countess slain during a session of the event day will not reappear in the following sessions. If not killed, she will reappear in the next session. 
5. Neutral cities where the Night Countesses appear are cursed, reducing their buffs (including capture buffs, alliance stone production speed, and season point growth). 
6. Each Night Countess spawn adds 1 stack of curse; max 3 stacks per neutral city. 
7. After slaying the Night Countess, all curses on that neutral city are removed. If the Night Countess is not defeated that day, the curse persists until 00:00 of the next event day (Apocalypse Time). 
8. Captured cities cannot be declared war on by other alliances during the event. 
9. If a cursed city is declared war on and captured by another alliance, the curse does not disappear, but the Night Countess will not appear there again that day. 
10. After the Night Countess is killed, all alliance members receive a kill reward. Alliance members who participated in the kill receive an additional participation reward. Both rewards are sent via mail.

Once healed, the Spinosaurus sends a certain number of gift rewards as thanks. Each event allows <color=#fb3b3b>up to 10 gift rewards</color>. 
9. <color=#fb3b3b>Achievement Missions</color> are shared across the entire State. After a mission is completed, all survivors in the State can claim the corresponding mission rewards.

strings.914056:
After a year of relaxing, Santa's waistline is more noticeable than a reindeer's nose... and Christmas is coming! To squeeze back down those chimneys, he's enrolled in a custom training camp to run, sweat, and get back in shape!

1. Use <color=#f07100>[Xmas Camp Pass]</color> to enter the course. During training, Santa's energy decreases over time and is also deducted upon hitting obstacles. <color=#f07100>The training session ends when energy drops to zero.</color>

2. You can pick up various items during the course for different effects:
 - [Arctic Energy Drink]: Restores Energy. A famous polar brand.
 - [Ice Skates]: Fills the boost gauge. Full gauge grants a speed boost.
 - [Magnet]: Increases item pickup range.
 - [Shield]: Prevents Energy loss from obstacles while active.
All item effects are temporary, with timers shown top-right.

3. After training, rewards are issued based on the distance run. Further distance means better rewards.

4. Use [Upgrade Points] in the [Arctic Senior Gym] to increase Santa's energy cap, base speed, and initial invincibility duration.

5. Little animal helpers will randomly provide different assist effects during the course. Refer to the [Animal Helper] page for instructions on obtaining them and their respective functions.

6. Use [Quick Sweep] to consume [Xmas Camp Passes] and immediately receive rewards based on your current best score, skipping the course.

7. The final <color=#f07100>10 minutes</color> before the event ends is the tally phase. To avoid data loss, you cannot enter the stage during the period, but you can use [Quick Sweep] to use up any remaining [Xmas Camp Passes].

As dawn approaches, the Vampire dispatches powerful guards to roam the State, hunting survivors for blood. We must unite to defeat these guards and protect our State! 

1. During the event, Vampire Guards will <color=#fb3b3b>actively attack survivors' Headquarters</color>! When attacking Headquarters, they bypass the city's guards and <color=#fb3b3b>directly damage Headquarters' durability</color>. 
2. During the event, <color=#fb3b3b>Kill Rewards for [Vampire Guards] can be claimed up to 5 times</color> a day. 
3. After defeating a [Vampire Guard] during the event, there is a chance to discover the Boss [Blaze Ogre]. 
4. All members of the team that discovers the [Blaze Ogre] will receive a <color=#fb3b3b>Discovery Reward</color>, which will be sent via mail. 
5. After the [Blaze Ogre] appears, it will enter a protection period. During this period, only survivors from the discoverer's alliance can launch rallies. 
6. All members of teams that deal damage to the [Blaze Ogre] will receive a <color=#fb3b3b>Participation Reward</color>; all members of the team that delivers the killing blow will receive a Kill Reward. 
7. To encourage all survivors in the State to unite and protect the State peace, <color=#fb3b3b>Achievement Missions</color> are available during the event. Mission progress is shared across the entire State. After a mission is completed, all survivors in the State can claim the corresponding mission rewards. 
8. Rankings are based on the total damage dealt by each survivor during the event. After the event ends, the corresponding ranking rewards will be sent via mail. 
9. After the event ends, scattered [Vampire Guards] will continue to appear in the world. Outside the event period, you can obtain Kill Rewards twice per day.

Background: 

1. The Endless Night Duke is the oldest and most terrifying existence in this world. In the long-lost bygone era, he wielded darkness as his reins and blood as his whip, ruling over the order of the world, as well as life and death itself. 
2. Over the long years, invincible solitude and boredom gnawed at his will. Eventually, he chose to slumber in the underground palace he had built himself. A millennium passed, and the old order crumbled during his sleep; even his name was buried by dust and mist.
3. Yet, the clamor of human warfare ultimately pierced the silence of the underground palace. He did not get angry; instead, upon waking, he sensed the presence of new prey. This long-missed amusement compelled him to open his scarlet eyes once more and personally forge his own new dark age. 


Event Rules: 

1. The Endless Night Duke event begins in the 4th week of the season and lasts for 7 weeks.
2. After the event starts, from 00:00 on Saturday to 00:00 on the following Thursday (server time), it is the Silver Ingot Donation Phase. Survivors need to donate Silver Ingots obtained from various events to the Capital, working together to forge a "Silver Artifact." The Silver Artifact can effectively counter the Endless Night Duke and weaken his power.
3. The Endless Night Duke will appear on Friday server time. The President can choose one of three time slots to gather the strength of the server's survivors to confront the Endless Night Duke.
4. In the battle against the Endless Night Duke, you can earn ranking reward based on your damage ranking. After defeating the Endless Night Duke, six Large Steel Plants will appear around the Capital. Send troops to gather there for a large amount of Steel.
5. If your State defeats him ahead of schedule, all survivors who dealt damage to the Endless Night Duke will receive a special Victory Reward. If the Silver Artifact was previously activated, the Victory Reward will be doubled!
6. Remember! The Endless Night Duke grows stronger over time. Survivors must race against time to defeat him completely before he evolves into his final form! Only then can the endless night curse be truly ended.
